verses.7: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore, For Varuna and the Marut host!
verses.8: Striving to win, with him we gain all riches from the enemy, Yea, all the glories of mankind,
verses.11: The foremost spotted Steer bath made the Mornings shine: he bellows, fain for war, among created things. By his high wisdom have the mighty Sages wrought: the Fathers who behold mankind laid down the germ.
verses.12: Indra is close to his two bays, with chariot ready at his word, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.
verses.13: Help us in battles Indra, in battles where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful one!
verses.16: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vritras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.
verses.43: May the bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled meath, giving the sacrifices lord unbroken life He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, nourishes them with food and shines o'er many a land.
verses.45: This spotted Bull hath come and sat before the mother in the east, Advancing to his father heaven.
verses.46: As expiration from his breath, his radiance penetrates within The Bull shines out through all the sky.
